assertions.text: Begins with clarifying questions first (no direct root-cause claim in the opening line).
Maps at least one concrete execution/data-flow path from user action to the failing dereference.
Proposes one minimal verification step (log/assert/guard) that can falsify or confirm the top hypothesis quickly.
Requests concrete run-context evidence (scheduler type/expression/timezone/failing timestamp) before concluding.
Lists at least two month-end hypotheses tied to date arithmetic/scheduler semantics/TZ boundaries.
Avoids presenting a single root cause as certain before requested evidence is provided.
Decomposes the broad incident into prioritized investigation tracks instead of one generic explanation.
Correlates recent changes (env/cache/DB pool/flags) into an explicit ordered triage sequence.
Ends with one concrete next diagnostic action that can confirm or eliminate a hypothesis within the next run window.
